title: Locate the misnamed 16px icon and still require the delivery filename
description: Same technical slots as specs/good.json, but icon-16.path is the actual file icon16.png while name remains icon-16.png. Against fixtures/bad/wrong-name this fails the name check only.

alphaPolicy.present: Pass only when File Vitals JSONL inspect reports image.has_alpha === true. Omitted has_alpha is observed as unknown and is not present.
alphaPolicy.absent: Pass only when File Vitals JSONL inspect reports image.has_alpha === false. Omitted has_alpha is observed as unknown and is not absent.
alphaPolicy.any: Do not fail the alpha check, including when has_alpha is omitted.
alphaPolicy.unknown: Pass only when has_alpha is omitted. Do not invent present or absent.
